name: Time to Strike
summary: At Hillsbrad's border, Lesh sends a warning east to Tarren Mill. Her coded words carry word from a quiet watch to Forsaken plans against the human settlers.

sections.title: A Watcher at the Border
sections.body: Deathstalker Lesh watches the valley from high ground near the border of Silverpine Forest and the Hillsbrad Foothills. Below her, human settlers and militia move through the valley. The Deathstalkers watch enemy settlements for the Undercity before its troops deploy. Lesh holds her post and asks passing Horde travelers to carry her gathered intelligence down the road to Tarren Mill.

sections.title: A Coded Beckon
sections.body: Lesh's message speaks in code: “The raven's cry from the west doth beckon.” Carried east along the road, it tells High Executor Darthalia that Hillsbrad's human defenses are vulnerable. For Darthalia and the dreadlord Varimathras, the signal means it is time to gather Forsaken forces and begin their campaigns against Hillsbrad's human defenders.

faq.q: What does Deathstalker Lesh's message mean?
aliases: what does the raven cry mean
faq.answer: “The raven's cry from the west doth beckon” is a coded report from Lesh's reconnaissance. It tells High Executor Darthalia that Hillsbrad's western approaches are poorly guarded and open to an immediate attack.
High Executor Darthalia commands Forsaken forces in the Hillsbrad Foothills. From Tarren Mill, she directs attacks against the Southshore humans and works closely with Varimathras in the Undercity.

faq.q: Why does Lesh send a courier instead of going herself?
faq.answer: Lesh is watching Hillsbrad's western edge. If she leaves her post, Forsaken surveillance there will have a blind spot, so she asks passing Horde travelers to carry her urgent dispatches.

faq.q: Where is this message meant to be delivered?
faq.answer: The message is meant for Tarren Mill, the main Horde stronghold in the region. Carry it east along the main road through the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why is Varimathras involved in Hillsbrad's affairs?
faq.answer: Varimathras is Sylvanas Windrunner's chief lieutenant and dreadlord advisor. From Undercity's Royal Quarter, he oversees much of Forsaken military and strategic planning, while High Executor Darthalia carries out his campaign orders in the region.

faq.q: What happens after this message is received?
faq.answer: When Darthalia learns Hillsbrad is vulnerable, she authorizes forceful attacks. Horde champions are sent to dismantle the farms, militia, and infrastructure of Hillsbrad.

angles.text: As Forsaken operatives, you help secure Lordaeron's eastern frontier against the remaining human Alliance when you carry Lesh's dispatch.
As a rogue, you recognize the Deathstalkers' covert watch and coded messages. They are the Undercity's elite guild of assassins and scouts.
As a member of the Horde, you are drawn deeper into the conflict between the Forsaken and the southern human settlements.
